game_title: Return Or Print – Frozen Well Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Snowy Hold – Frozen Well, a frozen village well: the hold guard must handle yeti raiders while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Or Print: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on.
theme: Snowy Hold – Frozen Well: a frozen village well
core_gameplay_loop: In Frozen Well, repeat each round: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on. Each round, yeti raiders strike the wall banner, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the court_score value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the wall banner from yeti raiders in Frozen Well: keep the court_score meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: court_score drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 42-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 5 (applied tier): Return Or Print
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Return Or Print' (Week 6 slot 15), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Frozen Well'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how court_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yeti raiders in Frozen Well.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 42 seconds while court_score > 0.
